dishes.name: Arnhemse meisjes
dishes.desc: Crisp, buttery puff-pastry cookies shaped like a bow, named after the traditional girls' costume. The city's own biscuit, sold in Arnhem's bakeries.

dishes.name: Gelderse rookworst
dishes.desc: Lightly smoked, coarse-ground pork sausage typical of Gelderland. Eaten on its own, in a roll or with stamppot.

dishes.name: Buckwheat pancake
dishes.desc: Thick pancake made with buckwheat flour, often with bacon and syrup. A classic of the Veluwe's forest pancake houses.

dishes.name: Gelderse appelstroop
dishes.desc: Thick, dark apple syrup spread on bread or pancakes, made from fruit of the Betuwe orchards. A staple of the Gelderland breakfast table.
